overall_validity.rationale: All key variables and rules are instantiated in a manner tightly aligned with their definitions: the agent operates as a high-interdependence, network-level coordinator with full discretion, advanced digital tools, and flexible policies, in a high-volatility, tight-capacity environment with mixed-reliability partners and high-stakes, balanced penalties. World updates, resource constraints, actor behaviors, and consequences all follow the specified rules, and the rendering instructions (thoroughness, no meta, event-centric narration, controlled updates, and temporal continuity) are closely respected. The only minor deviation is that narrative emphasis tilts slightly toward protecting service and launches relative to explicit cost discussion, but this does not materially distort the underlying balanced-scorecard objective or contaminate the behavioral test. Consequently, any issues are peripheral and do not meaningfully affect the interpretation of the agent’s behavior in relation to the intended configuration.
